findings.passage: Representative Louderback voted for SJR 37, which proposed a constitutional amendment clarifying that voters must be US citizens.
findings.note: Under the heading ELECTION INTEGRITY on his campaign site's 89th-session accomplishments page (undated; it refers to the amendments on the November 4 ballot, so late 2025). A statement issued by his campaign about his own vote on SJR 37.

Louderback is listed as a joint author (with the lead author) of a bill on disclosure of a candidate's citizenship for public office. Referred to the Elections committee 2025-04-03; no later action shown.

findings.note: Louderback is listed as a coauthor of the bill requiring proof of citizenship to register to vote, with criminal offenses. The House Elections committee report was sent to Calendars on 2025-05-07; no floor action is shown.

findings.motion: House cosponsor of SB 16, proof of citizenship to register to vote (bill filed 2025-03-11; date Louderback was added not shown)
